The new `_from_xarray` unconditionally attempts `_unflatten_snapshots` whenever the array has a snapshot dimension and the component has a network; it does not check semantics or the option. Thus an array with a flat, tuple-valued snapshot index and auxiliary `period`/`timestep` coordinates is now converted to a MultiIndex before pandas conversion, whereas the base implementation leaves that index flat, changing the returned result even under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`.
